messages:
ira: Heads-up — Azure reseller settlement for CloudChannel shows a -$24,512 credit on invoice AZ-2026-03-14. Our internal usage/charges don't line up. Anyone seen this?
marco: Do we know if this is a reseller-adjustment or a marketplace-level credit?
sara: It's a reseller pass-through via CloudChannel (they consolidate orders). I saw the notification but didn't reconcile details.
partners-bot: CloudChannel Settlement processed: invoice AZ-2026-03-14, amount -24512.00 USD, settlements_count=1 (see partner portal).
ira: Pasting the problematic lines from the invoice CSV we got from partner (sanitized):
```
InvoiceID,PartnerSKU,PartnerName,Amount,Currency,Note
AZ-2026-03-14,redwood-prod-v1,CloudChannel,-24512.00,USD,Consolidated credit - month-end reversal
AZ-2026-03-14,redwood-embeddings,CloudChannel,0.00,USD,Adjustment flag: true
```
lena: Can you attach the full settlement CSV from Azure portal? need the per-SKU breakdown to map to our internal product codes. Also who approved the reversal on their side?
sara: Uploading the partner CSV to Drive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xExampleLink (internal only) — file name: cloudchannel_az_settlement_2026-03-14.csv
marco: Quick check I ran against billing DB: `SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) FROM azure_settlements WHERE invoice_id='AZ-2026-03-14' GROUP BY invoice_id;` returns -24512. Looks like partner reported the credit, but our meter shows +24200 for the same period. There's a ~$3.3k delta.
ira: Is that delta the reseller fee/commission being applied incorrectly? CloudChannel was supposed to pass through gross charges, we invoice them monthly.
lena: If partner applied a credit for returned credits or chargeback, they should provide a supporting partner note. Without that we can't issue an adjustment. I'll ping partner ops.
sara: @partners-bot can you raise a partner ops ticket and request the partner's supporting docs+approval trail?
partners-bot: Ticket created: PART-4583 — Requesting CloudChannel supporting documentation for AZ-2026-03-14 settlement. Assigned to partners-ops. ETA 48h.
ira: For approvals — I can prep an adjustment invoice if we get the docs, but note our finance policy: adjustments >$10k need director approval. This one is >$10k.
lena: Confirmed — I can approve up to $10k. For the remaining amount we'll need finance director (cc: finance-director) sign-off.
marco: Suggest we block applying the partner credit in our revenue ledger until we receive the partner's signed adjustment form. Otherwise our recognized revenue will be wrong for the month.
sara: Agreed. I'll ask CloudChannel for a signed credit memo and the reason code. Also scheduling a 15m sync with partner ops + CloudChannel on Tue 14:00 PT.
ira: OK next steps: 1) partners-ops to collect signed credit memo (PART-4583) 2) lena to approve up to 10k immediately upon receipt 3) finance director sign-off for the remainder 4) hold posting until docs received. If anyone objects speak now :thinking:  
marco: No objections. Please add a quick note in the month close checklist so accounting doesn't post prematurely.
sara: Will do. I'll update the ticket with the Drive link and tag partner ops. Thanks all :thumbsup:
